install: claude mcp add --scope project cloudwatch --env AWS_PROFILE=<read-only-profile> --env FASTMCP_LOG_LEVEL=ERROR -- uvx awslabs.cloudwatch-mcp-server@latest
verify: Ask Claude Code to describe the log groups whose name starts with a given prefix.
read_only_mitigation: The server needs logs:StartQuery and logs:StopQuery, which are not read-only by name (they do not alter log data but queries are billed). Use a profile limited to the documented IAM actions listed at https://awslabs.github.io/mcp/servers/cloudwatch-mcp-server and keep time windows tight.
